title: Normalization of transported derived reduction systems
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E,L of Q_l and an embedding i:E -> L [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], schemes X,Y on which l is invertible, and f:X -> Y. For any specified whole-system reduction calculus S over E on Y [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], the two systems U_f(S.reduction(K)) and S_i(S.reduction(K)) [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems] are normalized [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site] for every ambient unbounded derived completed-integral module K. Both assertions concern the actual whole strict quotient system functors, with independent site and coefficient universes; no flatness or Tor condition on quotient inclusions is assumed.

lean.statement:
theorem transportedReductionSystems_normalized
    {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (_hlX : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.residueField x))
    (_hlY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.residueField y))
    (SY : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E Y) :
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E Y),
      IsNormalizedCoefficientSequence l E X
        ((integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l E f).obj (SY.reduction.obj K))) ∧
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E Y),
      IsNormalizedCoefficientSequence l L Y
        ((integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar l E L ι Y).obj (SY.reduction.obj K)))
